items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: the Julia Lee was way out there on 60th and Truce

ctx.x: It is, but it's -- it's scattered way out in the suburbs. Now, that was another thing even during our time. Kansas City wasn't directed to any one locality like, you know, the -- for instance, the Julia Lee was way out there on 60th and Truce -- yeah, 60th and Truce. And the George E. Lee was further out, At Toodie's and Tommy Douglas had a band way out. And the clubs were scattered around, but all the guys --
Were these clubs sort of in Black or white areas?
